findings.title: delegatecall usage
findings.message: Function VulnerableVault.runPlugin uses delegatecall, which can expose storage and execution-context risk.
findings.remediation: Avoid delegatecall unless the storage layout and trust boundary are explicitly controlled.

findings.title: selfdestruct usage
findings.message: Function VulnerableVault.emergencyDestroy can destroy the contract with selfdestruct.
findings.remediation: Remove selfdestruct patterns unless the shutdown flow is intentionally designed and reviewed.

findings.title: tx.origin used for authorization
findings.message: Function VulnerableVault.insecureWithdraw references tx.origin, which is unsafe for authorization decisions.
findings.remediation: Use msg.sender or explicit role checks instead of tx.origin for access control.

findings.title: External call before state update
findings.message: Function VulnerableVault.insecureWithdraw performs an external call before updating contract state.
findings.remediation: Apply checks-effects-interactions and update critical state before external calls.

findings.title: Missing access control on sensitive function
findings.message: Function VulnerableVault.uncheckedPayout appears sensitive but lacks obvious access control.
findings.remediation: Protect sensitive state-changing and fund-moving functions with explicit role or ownership checks.

findings.title: Unchecked low-level call result
findings.message: Function VulnerableVault.uncheckedPayout ignores the result of a low-level call.
findings.remediation: Capture and validate the return value of low-level calls before continuing execution.

findings.title: Timestamp or block value used as randomness
findings.message: Function VulnerableVault.drawRandomWinner uses block-controlled values in a randomness-like expression.
findings.remediation: Use a verifiable randomness source or a commit-reveal design instead of block-derived entropy.

findings.remediation: Use a verifiable randomness source or a commit-reveal design instead of block-derived entropy.

findings.title: Unbounded loop over storage or user-controlled collections
findings.message: Function VulnerableVault.airdrop contains a loop with a storage- or input-dependent bound.
findings.remediation: Bound loop sizes, batch work, or move untrusted iteration out of state-changing paths.
